notes.content:
We’ve just released a new update focused on improving the early gameplay experience and fixing some important issues.

[b]🛠 Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when players skipped the tutorial steps.
[*] Fixed the crafting menu exit button.
[*] Fixed tutorial guidance for using the Drill Arm.
[*] Fixed UI instructions while in spiritual mode.
[/list]

The tutorial is now fully linear to prevent players from accidentally skipping essential steps.

Thank you for your continued support of Genimas: Life Reborn! We’ll keep improving the experience with your feedback.

notes.title: 🌟 Genimas: Life Reborn - Version 1.2 Update (March 21, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We have released the Version 1.2 Update for Genimas: Life Reborn, featuring several improvements and fixes to enhance the gameplay experience. Here are the latest changes:

[b]✅ Improvements and Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the Early Access dialogue language.
[*] Fixed the shooting tutorial button.
[*] Added tutorial widget for Quest 11 Task 2.
[*] Changed interaction key from “L” to “F” for better gameplay accessibility.
[*] Resolved issues with jumping, attacking, secondary attacks, and stealth during conversations with NPCs.
[*] Added an indicator for "Go To" tasks that produces a VFX with sound (still under optimization).
[*] Implemented the language selection menu, with support for Japanese (may have errors).
[*] Improved map icons for better clarity.
[/list]

📌 Note: We are continuously working to improve the game experience. We truly appreciate your feedback and suggestions. If you encounter any issues, please feel free to report them through our Discord server.

Thank you for your support as we continue to improve Genimas: Life Reborn!

notes.title: 🛠️ Genimas: Life Reborn - Major Update for Demo and Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re excited to share our first major update for both the demo and the upcoming Early Access build of Genimas: Life Reborn. This update brings important bug fixes, quest improvements, first versions of the game’s main interfaces, and overall tweaks to prepare for Early Access.


[b]✅ Bug Fixes:[/b]
[b]Projectile deflection system fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] The character now properly deflects projectiles when holding the block button.
[*] While holding the button, defense colliders activate and trigger a sword animation to block or deflect incoming projectiles.
[*] Fixed a bug where releasing the button mid-animation left the character permanently stuck in block mode.
[*] Now, when you release the button, the character stops blocking and can take damage as expected.
[*] Fixed a control lock issue that sometimes happened when trying to deflect projectiles.
[/list]

⚙️ General Changes and Improvements (Demo & Early Access):
[list]
[*] Quest 2 improved: You now need to hit the training dummy 3 times to complete it.
[*] Hunting mission temporarily disabled due to bugs we're actively working on.
[*] Tree of Life relocated: Now placed behind Freyja’s house to shorten early quests and focus gameplay on the genetics system.
[*]Music adjustments to improve overall atmosphere and player immersion.[/list]

[b]First versions of key interfaces (UI) now implemented:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory system.
[*] Character menu.
[*] Genetics system.
[*] Quest log.
[/list]

This update will be live both in the demo and the Early Access build, so everyone will get to enjoy these improvements right away!

Thanks so much for playing and for all the feedback you’ve been sending us.
Remember, you can share ideas, report bugs, and follow development on our official Discord (link available on this Steam page).

We’re working hard to make Genimas: Life Reborn an unforgettable experience! 🌿

notes.title: 📣 Major Update for Genimas: Life Reborn!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42352690/802af7fcc148fa5b43c112163af1a31024cfc2f4.png[/img]

Greetings, adventurers of Midgar! 🌿✨
We’ve been working hard to improve your experience in Genimas: Life Reborn, and we’re thrilled to share the latest changes in this major update:

🛠️ Key Changes:

Drassil Redesign: A refreshed look that highlights his evolution and adaptability.
Freyja Redesign: A brand-new design to reflect her role as a mentor and mother.
Island Redesign and Level Design: The island has been transformed to provide a more immersive and detailed experience.
Gameplay UI Update: We’ve revamped the interface for better navigation and aesthetics.
New Quests Added: Quests 1 through 11 are now available, expanding the narrative and gameplay.
Animation Improvements:
Drassil now moves with more fluid and natural animations.
Freyja has new animations that reflect her personality and skills.
Freyja AI Programming: Freyja now acts more intelligently and interactively in the game.
Dialogue UI Update: Dialogue interactions are now clearer and visually appealing.
Tree of Life Redesign: This core element has been updated to better reflect its significance and unique aesthetic.
🎮 Explore these improvements and share your feedback on the forums. Thank you for being part of this epic adventure!

notes.title: Genimas: Life Reborn Updates - New Features & Enhanced Genetic System
notes.content:
[h1]COMING SOON:[/h1]
[h2][b]Get ready to experience "Genimas: Life Reborn" like never before! We've listened to your feedback and are thrilled to announce a series of enhancements and new features that will transform your adventure:[/b][/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]Evolution of the Genetic System: [/b]Discover the evolution of the automatic genetic system, which simulates real genetic exchange. By transferring their vital energy to the Tree of Life, characters can reincarnate with genetic improvements adapted to their environment, immersing you in a cycle of life and rebirth full of random surprises.
[*] [b]Character Redesign:[/b] Enhanced characters now feature a new, more detailed and vibrant look.
[*] [b]Advanced Animations:[/b] We've enhanced body and facial animations, giving characters unprecedented expressiveness and dynamism.
[*] [b]Improved Art: [/b]Enjoy more refined art throughout the game, including a redesigned Tree of Life and its fruits.
[*] [b]Interaction Cinematography:[/b] Interaction cinematics are now smoother and more emotional.
[*] [b]New Ranged Weapon and Attacks:[/b] Introducing a ranged weapon with a secondary attack and enhancements to the combo system.
[*] [b]Drill and Leg Gene Modifications:[/b] The drill and legs have received a visual overhaul, including features like turbo and double jump.
[*] [b]Manual Activation of Genes:[/b] You can now manually activate genes, such as thermal vision, avoiding unwanted automatic activations.
[*] [b]Enhanced Enemy System and Combat:[/b] Face enemies with improved mechanics and enjoy a more fluid combat system.
[*] [b]Expanded Crafting and Inventory Systems:[/b] Our crafting and inventory systems have been expanded to offer more options and ease of use.
[*] [b]New Quests and Minimap: [/b]Explore easily with the new minimap and immerse yourself in better-designed quests.
[*] [b]Renewed Hunting and Farming:[/b] Hunt new creatures like the deer and engage in the new tree-felling farming system.
[*] [b]Clothing System and Wear: [/b]Customize your adventure with a new clothing system that reflects wear over time.
[/olist]

These updates are designed to enrich your gameplay experience and take your adventure to new horizons. We hope you enjoy these improvements as much as we have enjoyed creating them for you!

Keep exploring, keep discovering in Genimas: Life Reborn!
